caption: Figure 7.15: Priorities are assigned to Tasks. The cores schedule independently from each other. The Tasks T2, T3 and T5 are executed in true parallelism. Tasks with the same priority on the same core will be executed in order of activation; Tasks with the same priority on different cores may not be executed in the order of activation, since the cores schedule independent from each other.
